title: The Days an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement Is Charged For
content:
What the shop charges for depends on where the agreement has got to: kit still out is charged across the agreement as written, kit not yet collected across the days it was booked for.

## The rule

Where the rental account carries at least one date the kit was out, and the agreement stands with the kit out, the days charged for are the length of the agreement.

Where the agreement stands with kit set aside and not yet collected, the days charged for are the days the agreement was written for.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the days charged for.

## The two conditions in combination

| The agreement stands | Dates the account carries for the kit being out | Days charged for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| with the kit out | 1 or more | the length of the agreement |
| with the kit out | none | nothing under this heading changes it |
| with kit set aside and not yet collected | either way | the days the agreement was written for |
| in any other state | either way | nothing under this heading changes it |

An agreement standing with kit set aside and not yet collected takes the days it was written for whether or not any date out stands against it.

## Worked counts on a hypothetical agreement

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement collected on the 10th of January and written to the 14th, so that its length is 5 days, and written for 5 days.

- The agreement stands with the kit out and the account carries 3 dates the kit was out: the days charged for are 5, the length of the agreement.
- The agreement stands with kit set aside and not yet collected: the days charged for are 5, the days it was written for.
- The agreement stands returned: nothing under this heading changes the days charged for.

## Point of judgement

**Three counts, not one.** The length of the agreement, the days the agreement was written for and the dates the account shows the kit out are three separate counts, and an agreement handed in early will show fewer dates out than its length.
